body:
## MCP fleet follow-up lane (stacked on #1150)

**Stacked on PR #1150's READY head (76abff766b)** — do not merge before #1150. Three commits, each independently revertable:

1. **66be55eaf6 — LOW audit findings closed** (`chore`): B1 four unit tests pin the health-probe hook's `--repo` emission (incl. the intentional task-orchestrator wrapper exception under a truthy repo root); B2 dead test local removed; B3 both backlog docs stop referencing deleted `scripts/start.sh`; B4 dead `SUBSYSTEM_RULES` entries removed from all three pr-docgen-sync copies; AGY's LOW copilot-instructions Quick-Reference tension resolved (`dopemux mcp start` for fleet, compose confined to the non-MCP PM stack); phantom `start_stack.sh` row removed from scripts context doc. Suites: 83 passed.

2. **0a2587b043 — M11 consumer-sweep evidence** (`docs`): supervisor D2 precondition satisfied — 19-consumer inventory with breakage risk, full endpoint classification, bounded rename checklist (incl. required network aliases for dopecon-bridge and adhd_engine, and the recommendation to consolidate on the already-existing `DOPEMUX_WORKFLOW_API_URL`). Bonus evidence: `/api/pm/work-items/*` routes proven DEAD by test execution (router never mounted — the reference doc claiming "Active" is wrong), and the service's FastMCP surface (37 tools) is structurally unwired (advertised `/sse` route doesn't exist).

3. **8f3a10b93a — P-24 ADR draft** (`docs/90-adr`, status **proposed**): project-scoped Kotlin task-orchestrator on leased ports per supervisor ruling D1 — `multi_project_singleton` stays banned, 7890 demoted to preferred-candidate, kill-and-replace narrowed to a same-project predicate, `switch-project` deletion as acceptance criterion. Acceptance of the ADR does not itself authorize code.

Remaining follow-up lanes (not in this PR): P22-F2 (`dopemux init` cli.py bypass rewire), P22-F3 (pre-existing Makefile/bridge/setup_dopemux paths), the M11 rename implementation itself, and per-route retirement evidence for the DEAD candidates.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

…(D2 precondition)

Complete consumer inventory (19 consumers classified by breakage risk),
per-endpoint classification (canonical/adapter/compat/dead), and the
bounded rename-packet checklist incl. network-alias requirements for
dopecon-bridge and adhd_engine.

Notable evidence beyond rename scope:
- /api/pm/work-items/* routes are DEAD - router never include_router()'d;
  proven by executing test_pm_tools.py (404s). The reference doc claiming
  them Active is wrong.
- The service's FastMCP surface (37 tools) is structurally unwired: never
  mounted, and /info advertises an /sse URL with no matching route.
- Env-var consolidation recommendation: DOPEMUX_WORKFLOW_API_URL already
  exists with the same default - use it, keep TASK_ORCHESTRATOR_URL as
  compat alias.

identity computed by identity.py (P-02) and consumed by wrappers (bash

same-project predicate - foreign containers never touched; per-leased-
port verification replaces RESERVED_SINGLETON_IDENTITY_PREFIX (jar has
no /info - initialize downgraded to service-family evidence, ownership
requires labels+mount); peer-preflight ADR reconciliation itemized;
migration M-TO-1..5 supersedes design M12; switch-project deletion is an
acceptance criterion. Status: proposed - acceptance does not authorize
code.
